### F-105 — The realm template duplicated the RBAC merge handler instead of reusing it

> _2026-08-18 · core/blong-kopi · resolved_

The blong-core skill documents the RBAC merge seed pattern (`accessAuthorizationMerge` reusing
`core.triple.merge`, with non-dotted capability names) and blong-realm points at it. The template
now reuses the shared handler in code, not just in docs: it ships
`meta/dbTest/accessAuthorizationMerge.yaml` with a fixed filename and deliberately NO `$subject`
placeholder, because the seed method is derived from the filename (`access.authorization.merge`) and
lands on blong-access's shared `accessAuthorizationMerge` handler attached to the `db` adapter. The
earlier `adapter/db/$subjectAuthorizationMerge.ts` duplicate handler was deleted; only the seed
CONTENT carries `$subject` placeholders.
